headline: Two boards, side by side
summary: Open a second board beside the one you are already using. Both stay in step, and closing the split asks you to save.

new.title: Split view
new.description: Use the control beside the minimap to open a second board in the same window. It slides in from the right and starts on Home, so you can pick a board. You cannot open the board that is already open on the left.

new.title: Click to choose a side
new.description: Click a board to work in it. The other side darkens so you can see which one is active. Moving the mouse no longer switches sides.

new.title: A close that asks to save
new.description: Closing split view asks you to save unsaved work on the right board. You can save, discard, or cancel, and you can try again if you cancel.

improved.title: One title bar
improved.description: The title bar runs across both boards. Minimize, maximize, close, and pin stay at the top-right, and the pin menu opens where you can use it.

improved.title: Settings follow both boards
improved.description: Theme, grid style, toolbar, and the rest of Settings apply to both panes. Each pane keeps its own minimap.

improved.title: Dialogs stay in their pane
improved.description: Settings and other windows fit inside the side that opened them. The Saved notice stays in that pane as well.

improved.title: A visible split
improved.description: A thin seam shows where the two boards meet, and you can drag it to resize them. The right tool tab stays on its icon until you open it.

improved.title: Steadier resizing
improved.description: Images, icons, and the item count stay still while you drag the window edges. They no longer squash or jitter.

fixed.title: Split view closes reliably
fixed.description: After you change the right board, closing split view still asks to save. The close control keeps working if you cancel.

fixed.title: The right tool tab stays put
fixed.description: Turning on Always on top no longer drops the right board's tool tab.
